title: Triples with Bitwise AND Equal To Zero
summary: For an integer array nums, count the number of triples (i, j, k) where 0 <= i, j, k < nums.length and the bitwise-AND of nums[i], nums[j], and nums[k] equals zero.
statement: For an integer array nums, count the number of triples (i, j, k) where 0 <= i, j, k < nums.length and the bitwise-AND of nums[i], nums[j], and nums[k] equals zero.
constraints: Count ordered triples of indices (i,j,k) whose three values AND to zero.
hints: Precompute how often each pairwise AND value occurs.
For each pair-mask, every number disjoint from it completes that many triples.
Counter(x&y for all ordered pairs), then sum count when mask&z==0.
Grouping the first two indices by AND preserves multiplicity and makes the third test direct.
